mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_chat_message (id, conversation_id, user_id, role, content, created_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{conversationId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{createdTime})
mapper.select: SELECT m.conversation_id AS conversationId, MAX(m.created_time) AS lastTime, COUNT(*) AS messageCount, (SELECT t1.content FROM t_chat_message t1 WHERE t1.conversation_id = m.conversation_id AND t1.user_id = m.user_id AND t1.role = 'user' ORDER BY t1.created_time ASC LIMIT 1) AS title, (SELECT t2.content FROM t_chat_message t2 WHERE t2.conversation_id = m.conversation_id AND t2.user_id = m.user_id ORDER BY t2.created_time DESC LIMIT 1) AS preview FROM t_chat_message m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY m.conversation_id, m.user_id ORDER BY MAX(m.created_time) DESC
SELECT user_id FROM t_chat_message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_chat_message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, conversation_id, user_id, role, content, created_time FROM t_chat_message WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_time DESC
